calls.video_title: Is Caterpillar a Sneaky Good AI Stock to Buy Right Now? | CAT Stock Analysis
calls.thesis: CONDITIONAL_BUY, first tracked for Parkevtate. Not a buying opportunity at ~$597: fairly valued to slightly overvalued (DCF $531 vs ~$597); forward P/E 18.5 roughly 1x EPS growth. 'Another 10 or 15% down and I can see myself upgrading Caterpillar stock to a buy' (tentative, not a firm trigger). Data-centre power demand booming, orders out to 2029, capacity to triple by 2030; but tariffs/inflation squeeze FCF to the low end of target. Note: caption file ends mid-sentence, so the closing line is cut off.
calls.base_case: Over 18% EPS growth over the next several years; operating margins near decade highs (19% cash flow from operations, 18% operating margin).
calls.bull_case: Power demand keeps soaring and capacity triples by 2030; data-centre energy bottleneck makes CAT a structural winner.
calls.bear_case: Tariffs and inflation keep squeezing margins and free cash flow; valuation stays ahead of the DCF.
